name: Active User
test-only-meta-description: An active user is a person who performs a meaningful action in an app within a set period.
test-only-body:
An active user is any person who completes at least one meaningful action inside an app during a defined window.

Why Active Users Matter

Tracking active users tells a product team whether growth is real usage.

Active User Metrics

| Metric | Window | Formula | |---|---|---| | DAU | 24 hours | Unique users per day | | MAU | 30 days | Unique users per month |

Related Terms

  • Retention rate
  • Stickiness

Key Takeaways

  • An active user completes a meaningful action within a set window.
